stoneAbsolution.name: Absolution
stoneAbsolution.desc: Holding it feels like being forgiven for something you never confessed.

stoneAdept.name: Adept
stoneAdept.desc: Tasks feel half-learned already while it sits in your pocket.

stoneAdventure.name: Adventure
stoneAdventure.desc: It points no particular direction, yet always seems eager to leave.

stoneApe.name: Ape
stoneApe.desc: Rough-knuckled to the touch. It grips back.

stoneApocalypse.name: Apocalypse
stoneApocalypse.desc: Everything reflected in its surface looks like ash.

stoneArmour.name: Armour
stoneArmour.desc: It rings like a struck breastplate when tapped.

stoneAvatar.name: Avatar
stoneAvatar.desc: Your reflection in it stands a little taller than you do.

stoneAxe.name: Axe
stoneAxe.desc: One side of it is always, somehow, the sharp side.

stoneAlchemy.name: Alchemy
stoneAlchemy.desc: Left in a pouch overnight, it turns one copper coin in there to something almost gold.

stoneAntidote.name: Antidote
stoneAntidote.desc: Bitter to hold. The bitterness fades from whatever it touches, into it.

stoneCatalyst.name: Catalyst
stoneCatalyst.desc: It is never consumed by anything it starts, and it starts a great deal.

stoneCrucible.name: Crucible
stoneCrucible.desc: Warm on one face and cold on the other, and it will not say which is which.

stoneBalance.name: Balance
stoneBalance.desc: It cannot be made to tip, roll, or fall. It simply settles.

stoneBat.name: Bat
stoneBat.desc: It twitches at sounds too high to hear.

stoneBear.name: Bear
stoneBear.desc: Heavier every time you doubt yourself.

stoneBee.name: Bee
stoneBee.desc: It hums, faintly and industriously, dawn to dusk.

stoneBird.name: Bird
stoneBird.desc: Toss it and it falls just a little slower than it should.

stoneBlight.name: Blight
stoneBlight.desc: Grass yellows in a neat ring wherever it rests overnight.

stoneBlood.name: Blood
stoneBlood.desc: It beats, very slowly, when held against the skin.

stoneBone.name: Bone
stoneBone.desc: Dry, porous, and older than any grave you've ever seen.

stoneBow.name: Bow
stoneBow.desc: It hums with tension, like a string held at full draw.

stoneBrush.name: Brush
stoneBrush.desc: Tiny burrs cling to it that no one ever finds the plant for.

stoneCage.name: Cage
stoneCage.desc: Small things circle it warily, as if the door might still shut.

stoneCat.name: Cat
stoneCat.desc: It lands face-up no matter how it's dropped.

stoneCattle.name: Cattle
stoneCattle.desc: Warm, placid, and impossible to hurry.

stoneCelestial.name: Celestial
stoneCelestial.desc: On clear nights it hangs a fraction above your palm.

stoneChain.name: Chain
stoneChain.desc: Whatever pouch it's kept in, the drawstring knots itself.

stoneChampion.name: Champion
stoneChampion.desc: It sits heaviest in the hand of whoever just lost.

stoneClaw.name: Claw
stoneClaw.desc: Its edges catch on everything, though it looks perfectly smooth.

stoneCloth.name: Cloth
stoneCloth.desc: Soft-surfaced stone that folds light around itself like drapery.

stoneCloud.name: Cloud
stoneCloud.desc: It weighs almost nothing on cloudy days.

stoneCold.name: Cold
stoneCold.desc: Frost forms on its shadow, not its surface.

stoneCoral.name: Coral
stoneCoral.desc: It grows, imperceptibly, and only ever underwater.

stoneCorrupt.name: Corrupt
stoneCorrupt.desc: Beautiful, and everything near it slowly becomes less so.

stoneCrocodile.name: Crocodile
stoneCrocodile.desc: It waits. That is all it does, and it does it perfectly.

stoneCrystal.name: Crystal
stoneCrystal.desc: Light entering it comes out sorted by color, and slightly late.

stoneCrops.name: Crops
stoneCrops.desc: Fields within sight of it never fail. Farmers fight wars over less.

stoneDance.name: Dance
stoneDance.desc: It rocks in time to music only it can hear.

stoneDark.name: Dark
stoneDark.desc: Seems to drink the light around it.

stoneDeath.name: Death
stoneDeath.desc: Flies will not land on it.

stoneDeep.name: Deep
stoneDeep.desc: Press it to your ear: pressure, cold, and something singing far below.

stoneDeer.name: Deer
stoneDeer.desc: It is always the first thing in the room to notice you.

stoneDefiance.name: Defiance
stoneDefiance.desc: It has never once rolled the way it was thrown.

stoneDimension.name: Dimension
stoneDimension.desc: Its far side is farther away than it should be.

stoneDiscord.name: Discord
stoneDiscord.desc: Two of them in one room will not stop arguing, silently.

stoneDog.name: Dog
stoneDog.desc: It is inexplicably pleased to see you, every single time.

stoneDominion.name: Dominion
stoneDominion.desc: Other stones arrange themselves around it when no one is watching.

stoneDuck.name: Duck
stoneDuck.desc: Water rolls off it. So, somehow, does misfortune.

stoneDust.name: Dust
stoneDust.desc: It is always the last thing to settle and the first to rise.

stoneEarth.name: Earth
stoneEarth.desc: Heavy and dense, older than the hills it was pulled from.

stoneEcho.name: Echo
stoneEcho.desc: Speak near it and your words come back a heartbeat late, slightly kinder.

stoneElastic.name: Elastic
stoneElastic.desc: Squeeze it and it takes your hand's shape; let go and it forgets, slowly.

stoneElemental.name: Elemental
stoneElemental.desc: Warm on one face, cold on another, humming on a third.

stoneEye.name: Eye
stoneEye.desc: You can never quite shake the feeling that it has noticed you first.

stoneFeast.name: Feast
stoneFeast.desc: Food near it never spoils, and never lasts either.

stoneFeeble.name: Feeble
stoneFeeble.desc: Lifting it is easy. Putting it down leaves you tired.

stoneFire.name: Fire
stoneFire.desc: Warm to the touch, with a slow inner smoulder that never quite goes out.

stoneFish.name: Fish
stoneFish.desc: It slips from your grip exactly as often as it wants to.

stoneFlea.name: Flea
stoneFlea.desc: Blink and it is on the other side of the table.

stoneFlesh.name: Flesh
stoneFlesh.desc: Warm. Faintly yielding. Best not held for long.

stoneFocus.name: Focus
stoneFocus.desc: The room grows quieter the longer you look at it.

stoneFoot.name: Foot
stoneFoot.desc: Roads feel shorter with it in your boot. Not comfortable -- shorter.

stoneFork.name: Fork
stoneFork.desc: It always comes to rest pointing two ways at once.

stoneFox.name: Fox
stoneFox.desc: Count your coins after handling it. The count will be right -- barely.

stoneFrog.name: Frog
stoneFrog.desc: Damp, patient, and gone the moment you glance away.

stoneFungus.name: Fungus
stoneFungus.desc: It was slightly larger this morning. It always was.

stoneGathering.name: Gathering
stoneGathering.desc: Lost buttons, stray pins, old keys -- they all end up beside it.

stoneGlass.name: Glass
stoneGlass.desc: Transparent from one side only. It chooses which.

stoneGoat.name: Goat
stoneGoat.desc: It cannot be knocked off any surface it decides to occupy.

stoneGrazen.name: Grazen
stoneGrazen.desc: A steady, grazing warmth, like a barn in winter.

stoneGrowth.name: Growth
stoneGrowth.desc: Fine green tendrils cross its surface -- more of them each morning.

stoneGun.name: Gun
stoneGun.desc: It smells faintly of smoke that hasn't happened yet.

stoneHair.name: Hair
stoneHair.desc: Fine filaments cover it, always combed, never by you.

stoneHammer.name: Hammer
stoneHammer.desc: Everything it rests on ends up slightly more level.

stoneHand.name: Hand
stoneHand.desc: It fits every palm perfectly, including ones far too small.

stoneHarmonic.name: Harmonic
stoneHarmonic.desc: Hum any note near it and the note comes back in tune.

stoneHealer.name: Healer
stoneHealer.desc: Old scars ache less in the room where it is kept.

stoneHeidel.name: Heidel
stoneHeidel.desc: It is warm the way a long-ridden mount is warm.

stoneHook.name: Hook
stoneHook.desc: Whatever you reach for, it is somehow already snagged on this.

stoneHorse.name: Horse
stoneHorse.desc: Hold it and distant hoofbeats keep your heart's time.

stoneHunger.name: Hunger
stoneHunger.desc: It is lighter after meals. Yours.

stoneHunt.name: Hunt
stoneHunt.desc: It warms when something you're looking for is near.

stoneIce.name: Ice
stoneIce.desc: Stays frozen in a closed fist on a summer day.

stoneInevitability.name: Inevitability
stoneInevitability.desc: Drop it, and it lands where it was always going to.

stoneJudgement.name: Judgement
stoneJudgement.desc: Liars find its surface uncomfortably warm.

stoneJustice.name: Justice
stoneJustice.desc: Stolen goods carried beside it grow unbearably heavy.

stoneKarmic.name: Karmic
stoneKarmic.desc: Kindness done while carrying it has a way of circling back armed.

stoneKnife.name: Knife
stoneKnife.desc: It is always closer to hand than you remember leaving it.

stoneKnowledge.name: Knowledge
stoneKnowledge.desc: Books left open near it are found open to the useful part.

stoneLife.name: Life
stoneLife.desc: Cut flowers last weeks in the same room as it.

stoneLight.name: Light
stoneLight.desc: Glows softly at dusk, like a coal of pure daylight.

stoneLightning.name: Lightning
stoneLightning.desc: Crackles faintly when two are carried together.

stoneLizard.name: Lizard
stoneLizard.desc: It suns itself. On overcast days it sulks.

stoneLocust.name: Locust
stoneLocust.desc: Grain stores count themselves nervously around it.

stoneLurker.name: Lurker
stoneLurker.desc: It is always in the darkest corner of wherever it is kept.

stoneMagic.name: Magic
stoneMagic.desc: Candlelight bends toward it, just slightly, like a bow.

stoneMagus.name: Magus
stoneMagus.desc: Written spells near it correct their own spelling.

stoneMalign.name: Malign
stoneMalign.desc: It has never done anything wrong that anyone could prove.

stoneManatee.name: Manatee
stoneManatee.desc: Nothing about your day feels urgent while you hold it.

stoneMight.name: Might
stoneMight.desc: Jars open easily in the household that keeps it.

stoneMirror.name: Mirror
stoneMirror.desc: Its reflection of you is a half-second behind, and knows it.

stoneMoment.name: Moment
stoneMoment.desc: Water drips slower beside it. Guests stay longer.

stoneMonkey.name: Monkey
stoneMonkey.desc: Knots tied around it are found untied, and neatly coiled.

stoneMoon.name: Moon
stoneMoon.desc: It waxes and wanes a day behind the sky.

stoneMouse.name: Mouse
stoneMouse.desc: Cats stare at it for hours. It outlasts them.

stoneMyriad.name: Myriad
stoneMyriad.desc: Every glance finds a slightly different stone.

stoneNeedle.name: Needle
stoneNeedle.desc: It finds the gap in everything -- cloth, armor, arguments.

stoneNet.name: Net
stoneNet.desc: Things dropped near it are caught before they land. Usually by it.

stoneOctopus.name: Octopus
stoneOctopus.desc: It has moved. No one has ever seen it move.

stoneOmen.name: Omen
stoneOmen.desc: Birds cross the sky above it in numbers that mean something.

stoneOmens.name: Omens
stoneOmens.desc: Its warnings come in threes, and the third is always right.

stonePangolin.name: Pangolin
stonePangolin.desc: Rolled against danger, its seams simply vanish.

stonePaper.name: Paper
stonePaper.desc: Feather-light, and impossible to tear along the grain of your intent.

stonePeace.name: Peace
stonePeace.desc: Arguments in its presence trail off, unembarrassed, unfinished.

stonePersistence.name: Persistence
stonePersistence.desc: Dripping water wore a channel in it once. It grew back.

stonePlant.name: Plant
stonePlant.desc: Left on soil, it is found half-buried by morning -- roots down.

stonePotent.name: Potent
stonePotent.desc: Everything brewed, forged, or sworn near it comes out stronger.

stonePreparation.name: Preparation
stonePreparation.desc: You packed exactly what you needed today. It approves.

stonePure.name: Pure
stonePure.desc: Water clears beside it. So, briefly, do intentions.

stonePurgation.name: Purgation
stonePurgation.desc: It is warm the way a fever breaking is warm.

stoneRabbit.name: Rabbit
stoneRabbit.desc: It is soft, alert, and already gone.

stoneRain.name: Rain
stoneRain.desc: It is always the first thing in the house to smell the storm.

stoneRake.name: Rake
stoneRake.desc: The ground around it is always suspiciously tidy.

stoneRat.name: Rat
stoneRat.desc: Whatever happens to the ship, this will not go down with it.

stoneReach.name: Reach
stoneReach.desc: Shelf-top things are, around it, mysteriously within arm's length.

stoneReaper.name: Reaper
stoneReaper.desc: Wheat bows as you pass while you carry it. So do old soldiers.

stoneRebirth.name: Rebirth
stoneRebirth.desc: Broken beside it, things are later found mended -- and changed.

stoneRenewal.name: Renewal
stoneRenewal.desc: It smells faintly of the first day of spring, all year.

stoneResolute.name: Resolute
stoneResolute.desc: Once set down deliberately, it takes two hands to lift.

stoneRuin.name: Ruin
stoneRuin.desc: It looks like the last standing stone of something vast.

stoneRune.name: Rune
stoneRune.desc: Markings surface and fade on it, always almost legible.

stoneSand.name: Sand
stoneSand.desc: It sheds a pinch of sand daily and never grows smaller.

stoneSceptre.name: Sceptre
stoneSceptre.desc: Held aloft, it makes any announcement feel official.

stoneSerene.name: Serene
stoneSerene.desc: Your breathing slows to match something inside it.

stoneShark.name: Shark
stoneShark.desc: It drifts toward the smell of blood, an inch an hour.

stoneShield.name: Shield
stoneShield.desc: Thrown objects miss whoever carries it, narrowly, every time.

stoneShimmer.name: Shimmer
stoneShimmer.desc: It is never quite the color you remember it being.

stoneShip.name: Ship
stoneShip.desc: It rocks gently at rest, riding a swell that isn't there.

stoneShovel.name: Shovel
stoneShovel.desc: Soil parts around it eagerly, as if remembering.

stoneSin.name: Sin
stoneSin.desc: It is exactly as heavy as the worst thing you ever did.

stoneSky.name: Sky
stoneSky.desc: Looking at it too long gives you vertigo -- upward.

stoneSloth.name: Sloth
stoneSloth.desc: It gets everywhere it means to go. Eventually.

stoneSmoke.name: Smoke
stoneSmoke.desc: Its edges blur when watched directly.

stoneSnake.name: Snake
stoneSnake.desc: It is warmer on the side facing you.

stoneSong.name: Song
stoneSong.desc: Hum near it and strangers hum your tune for days.

stoneSpear.name: Spear
stoneSpear.desc: It always comes to rest aimed at the door.

stoneSpider.name: Spider
stoneSpider.desc: Fine silk lines anchor it to the room, respun nightly.

stoneSpike.name: Spike
stoneSpike.desc: However it is set down, something sharp faces up.

stoneStaff.name: Staff
stoneStaff.desc: Lean on it in spirit and it holds.

stoneStar.name: Star
stoneStar.desc: It twinkles. Stones should not twinkle.

stoneStars.name: Stars
stoneStars.desc: Pinpricks of light drift across it in constellations no chart shows.

stoneSun.name: Sun
stoneSun.desc: Shadows near it fall at noon's angle, all day.

stoneSurge.name: Surge
stoneSurge.desc: Everything it touches happens slightly more at once.

stoneSwift.name: Swift
stoneSwift.desc: It always seems to reach your hand a moment before you go looking for it.

stoneSword.name: Sword
stoneSword.desc: It sings, very quietly, when drawn across a whetstone it never needs.

stoneTechnology.name: Technology
stoneTechnology.desc: Fine seams cross its surface. Sometimes they are elsewhere.

stoneTentacle.name: Tentacle
stoneTentacle.desc: It is holding something. It has always been holding something.

stoneThread.name: Thread
stoneThread.desc: A single loose thread trails from it, connected to nothing, taut.

stoneTrap.name: Trap
stoneTrap.desc: Reaching for it always takes a heartbeat of courage.

stoneTree.name: Tree
stoneTree.desc: Rings mark its heart, one more each year.

stoneTrowel.name: Trowel
stoneTrowel.desc: Walls raised near it stand truer than the plumb line says.

stoneTurtle.name: Turtle
stoneTurtle.desc: Nothing has ever gotten into it. Nothing has seen it try.

stoneUndeath.name: Undeath
stoneUndeath.desc: It is cold, and it is not resting.

stoneVast.name: Vast
stoneVast.desc: It is small in the hand and enormous in the mind.

stoneVenom.name: Venom
stoneVenom.desc: A drop of something beads on it, forever about to fall.

stoneVisage.name: Visage
stoneVisage.desc: From the corner of the eye it has features. Familiar ones.

stoneVision.name: Vision
stoneVision.desc: Stare through it at the horizon and the horizon steps closer.

stoneVoid.name: Void
stoneVoid.desc: It casts no shadow. It is one.

stoneWar.name: War
stoneWar.desc: Steel within a room of it will not stay sheathed unattended.

stoneWasp.name: Wasp
stoneWasp.desc: It remembers being swatted at. It remembers everything.

stoneWater.name: Water
stoneWater.desc: Cool and faintly damp, no matter how long it's carried.

stoneWhale.name: Whale
stoneWhale.desc: Press it to your chest and something enormous answers, far away.

stoneWheel.name: Wheel
stoneWheel.desc: It rolls uphill exactly as easily as down.

stoneWhip.name: Whip
stoneWhip.desc: Snap your wrist while holding it and the air flinches.

stoneWind.name: Wind
stoneWind.desc: Unnaturally light. Hums faintly in a stiff breeze.

stoneWing.name: Wing
stoneWing.desc: Falling with it in hand takes noticeably longer than it should.

stoneWolf.name: Wolf
stoneWolf.desc: Alone it is quiet. Near others of its kind it is warm.

stoneWood.name: Wood
stoneWood.desc: It is stone to the eye and timber to the palm.

stoneWrath.name: Wrath
stoneWrath.desc: It is hot-tempered glass-smooth rage, patiently waiting for a reason.

stoneZeal.name: Zeal
stoneZeal.desc: Held aloft, it makes any cause feel briefly, dangerously simple.

stoneDivineWar.name: the Unbroken Line
stoneDivineWar.phrase: the rank that does not break
stoneDivineWar.desc: Held in the hand it steadies the arm, and will not let it lower.

stoneDivineKnowledge.name: the Ten Thousand Pages
stoneDivineKnowledge.phrase: a fact you did not have
stoneDivineKnowledge.desc: Questions you had not thought to ask arrive fully formed.

stoneDivinePurity.name: the Unmarked
stoneDivinePurity.desc: It comes out of a bog as clean as it went in, and so does your hand.

stoneDivineHealing.name: the Green Mercy
stoneDivineHealing.desc: Old scars ache pleasantly, the way a thing does when it is finally healing.

stoneDivineDeath.name: the Last Door
stoneDivineDeath.desc: Everything it touches settles, and stays settled.

stoneDivineHeros.name: the Deed Remembered
stoneDivineHeros.desc: You catch yourself standing straighter, in case someone is watching.

stoneDivineLiberty.name: the Open Hand
stoneDivineLiberty.desc: Doors feel lighter. Some of them were not locked to begin with.

stoneDivineDominion.name: the Seated Crown
stoneDivineDominion.phrase: a thing that will not be moved
stoneDivineDominion.desc: It sits in the palm as though the palm were built to hold it.
